newsitem.title: UK: Higher prices scare off buyers on UK meals market.
newsitem.headline: Higher prices scare off buyers on UK meals market.

text.p: Higher prices on the UK meals and feeds market drove most buyers away on Monday.
High protein soymeal rose by as much as six stg a tonne ex-mill and three stg ex-store.
Old crop rapemeal from the Erith mill was unchanged while new crop was one to two stg higher.
Old crop rapemeal ex-mill Liverpool was two to three stg up while new crop was one to four stg higher. In Hull only new crop was offered, at one to four stg up from Friday's levels.
Sunflower meal and pellets were unchanged.
"Trade has been hopeless today, but we could see a pickup in business after the first week in May," said one broker.
